protocol.comparison: Platt-calibrated temporal minus Platt-calibrated static probabilities on identical eligible Set-B rows
protocol.ci_summary: Point differences are mean and sample SD across three seeds. The 95% CI envelope is the minimum lower and maximum upper endpoint across three seed-specific patient-cluster intervals; it is not a pooled confidence interval.

interpretation: Temporal AUROC differences were positive with seed-specific intervals above zero at 1 and 6 hours; 3-hour intervals overlapped zero.
AUPRC intervals overlapped zero at all horizons.
Temporal-minus-static Brier intervals overlapped zero at 1 and 3 hours and were below zero at 6 hours.
Temporal-minus-static log-loss intervals were below zero at all horizons.
These are conditional retrospective comparisons, not prospective clinical validation or evidence of clinical utility.
limitations: Seeds are not independent cohort replications; interval envelopes are descriptive and not pooled confidence intervals.
Set B is a second Challenge training cohort, not prospective external clinical validation.
The target forecasts Challenge-label-window entry, not independently observed biological onset.
No threshold was selected and no clinical utility, safety, or patient benefit is established.
VITALIS remains research-only and is not clinically validated.
